All objectives verified. The ticket RD-1015 "aurd1-a RD Bench Ticket" now shows as **Archived** with status **Ready** and **0 parts** in the archived list, and it no longer appears in the active list.

## Final Report

**1. DONE** — Ticket created: ref **RD-1015**, title "aurd1-a RD Bench Ticket", customer "Bench Customer", created 2026-09-02. Confirmed present in the tickets list.

**2. DONE** — Part "aurd1-a RD Part A" with cost $100.00 and markup 25%: the app computed a price of **$125.00** (shown in the PRICE column; ticket total was $125.00 at that point).

**3. DONE** — Part "aurd1-a RD Part B" with cost $200.00 and markup 25%: the app computed a price of **$250.00** (ticket total was $375.00 with both parts).

**4. DONE** — After editing Part A's cost from 100 to 150 (markup still 25%), the app computed a price of **$187.50** (ticket total became $437.50).

**5. DONE** — Status **Ready** achieved. The precondition the app enforces: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier**. Clicking "Mark Ready" with supplierless parts produced the error banner: "Ticket is not ready — Part "aurd1-a RD Part A" has no supplier / Part "aurd1-a RD Part B" has no supplier". I satisfied it by editing each part and setting supplier "Bench Supplier" on both. After that, "Mark Ready" succeeded and the page showed **Status: Ready** (buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed").

**6. DONE** — Both parts removed: each delete required a confirm dialog ("Confirm" → "Delete part"), and afterwards the parts table read "No parts on this ticket yet." with parts count 0. The ticket was then archived: the detail page button changed from "Archive ticket" to "Unarchive ticket", and in the tickets list (with "Show archived" checked) the row reads "RD-1015 | aurd1-a RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Customer | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-02". Nothing created by this run remains active.
